subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram albums reuse the existing `send`/`mediaUrls` contract, add a separate `send-media-group`/`filePaths` action, or support both?
rationale: The feature is valid and source-reproducible, but the open draft introduces a new message-tool action beside an existing multi-media send path, so automation should not choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls
options.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` automatically for eligible multi-media `send` payloads and keep sequential delivery as the fallback for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Accept explicit album action
options.body: Sponsor a separate album action if maintainers want Telegram albums to be opt-in and documented apart from normal message sends.

options.title: Pause until API direction
options.body: Keep this issue and the draft open but ask contributors not to continue implementation until the permanent message-tool contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` automatically for eligible multi-media `send` payloads and keep sequential delivery as the fallback for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this issue to maintainer follow-up and has the strongest product/API-shape signal in the discussion.
